summary: Iteration 3 — tested the new rule-based StockAnalysisService. Extended pytest suite to 19 tests (all pass 100%): unit test on StockAnalysisService.analyse for RELIANCE validates trend/strength_score in [0,100]/stars in {2,3,4,5}/classification/trade_setup in the 5 allowed values/risk in Low|Medium|High/action in Watch|Buy on Breakout|Wait|Avoid/insight <=60 words and no banned words (guaranteed|certain|sure shot); LLM/network isolation grep across /app/backend/analysis (no openai/anthropic/requests/httpx/urllib/litellm/emergentintegrations). Rankings API returns exactly 10 items with rank 1..10, scores descending, all new keys present, and setup/risk/action within allowed enums; also insight sanitized. /api/stock/RELIANCE and /api/stock/TCS both include strengthScore, stars, classification, tradeSetup, riskLevel, suggestedAction, insight. /api/watchlist rows now include strengthScore/stars/tradeSetup/riskLevel/suggestedAction alongside legacy fields. Legacy endpoints (watchlist CRUD, trades CRUD LONG/SHORT with pnl, settings GET/PUT with persistence, market-summary, stocks search, stock detail 404) still pass. Frontend Playwright E2E: card renamed 'Today's Rankings' (case-insensitive text match — CSS uppercases it), 10 rows rendered with rank pill (#01-#10), score bar + numeric score, ★ stars glyph, trend badge, setup badge, risk badge, action pill (all via data-testid ranking-{stars,trend,setup,risk,action}-{SYMBOL}). Chart card shows detail-strength-score, detail-stars, detail-suggested-action, detail-badges group with detail-badge-trend/setup/risk, and detail-insight paragraph containing template phrase 'Price is above ...'. Clicking a different watchlist row (RELIANCE -> TCS) updated the chart subtitle and re-rendered insight/badges/action. Navigation to /watchlist, /journal, /settings and back to / all render without errors. Frontend contains no analysis logic — only rendering references (verified via grep).

issues: All 10 seeded stocks satisfy every scoring rule and therefore all display strengthScore=100 with 5 stars, Bullish trend, Low risk, Buy on Breakout — the leaderboard has no visual differentiation. Seed data (STOCKS_BY_SYMBOL) should include a spread of RSI / volume / distance-from-day-high values so the scoring/classification tiers (Excellent / Strong Watch / Watch / Ignore) are actually exercised. Currently the classification/stars/action columns look ornamental.
Pre-existing recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warning still present (flagged in iterations 1 & 2).

action_items: LOW: Diversify seed data intraday fields (rsi, volume vs avg_volume, day_high vs price) so the scoring engine actually produces a spread of scores/stars/classifications on the Today's Rankings leaderboard — currently every seeded stock scores a perfect 100/5★.
critical_code_review_comments: StockAnalysisService is cleanly separated (analysis/service.py + scoring_config.py), pure functions, deterministic, no I/O. Nice module-level singleton pattern.
MAX_SCORE derived from SCORING_RULES sum — good, avoids drift.
Insight generator is fully template-based and defensively truncates at 60 words. No banned words appear in any generated insight across all seeded stocks.

routers/market.py opportunities() sorts by (strength_score, price) desc — a stable secondary key. Ties on score (all 100 here) fall back to price so ranks are deterministic. Consider using changePct or symbol as tie-breaker for more meaningful order.
watchlist enrichment handles unknown symbols gracefully with a placeholder — good defensive coding.
Frontend contains zero analysis logic — only rendering. Verified via grep: strengthScore/tradeSetup appear only in types, service DTOs, and JSX render sites.
Legacy Opportunity schema still exists in schemas.py but is unused now that rankings return Ranking — safe to remove in a cleanup pass.
Consider adding pytest test that asserts pnl sign for SHORT (still flagged from iter 2 — currently SHORT winning trade returns negative pnl).
seed_data_creation: None new. Watchlist state persists from iteration 2 (9 items, ITC removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Analysis engine fully wired end-to-end. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_tradelens_api.py now covers 19 tests including analysis unit + LLM-isolation grep + rankings shape/order + stock detail parametrized + watchlist enrichment. Watchlist has 9 symbols (RELIANCE,TCS,HDFCBANK,INFY,TATAMOTORS,BHARTIARTL,SBIN,MARUTI,ADANIENT). All seeded stocks currently score 100/5★ — expected given seed values satisfy every rule; not a bug per spec, but a data-tuning follow-up.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two test failures on first run were stale expectations from iteration 2 (opportunities schema key renamed score->strengthScore, watchlist length 10->9 after ITC deletion). Fixed both in the test file; not code bugs.
